text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is finally drawing 
near. As Admire Vega prepares, I casually 
ask if she's feeling nervous—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, her answer was "yes." Until 
now, running for the sake of her mission 
was all that mattered. But now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now, she has so much on her mind— 
her own desire to win, her rivals, and 
more. That is why she is so nervous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Embracing even the tension, she truly 
enjoyed the race and aimed earnestly for 
victory as her Trainer sent her off to the 
track where her rivals waited.
